More musing on us needing to pay attention to what the Scion said. Here's every word spoken by the Scion:

It's about time.
I see you are not quite as dense as you seem, little heroes of earth.
Like those you have battled before me and continue to fight now, I am but a scion of the cosmic entity who now seeks to destroy all.
It found me beyond space and time and offered me a collar.
Of course, I fought it.
But its power was far too great.
I learned three things.
I'm glad you asked, Mr. Riske.
First, that it could be damaged.
Second, that it had vast untold power.
And lastly, that it wanted to destroy everything.
And that it had such a goal gave me everything I needed.
You will fight it.
Use what I have told you.
Eventually, it will call me to fight you.
But I know how tenacious and resourceful you can be.
I will be there when you weaken it, and I will have its power for my own.
Because, sweet child, I do not want to destroy everything, so me with this power is a far better outcome than you can hope for.
You cannot defeat it without me, and it will exterminate all reality if left unopposed.
You know what you must do.

I can see the opening bit just being in-universe taunting, but I still think it seems indicative, along with the "Use what I have told you" comment and that the goal of destroying everything is "everything I needed".
